text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both flat to slightly positive over 24 hours, with BTC holding steady near $84k while ETH remains subdued at $2.7k, suggesting traders are cautious despite elevated sentiment. The Fear & Greed index at 74 (Greed) and rising over the past week indicates growing optimism, but relatively modest price momentum and $64B in daily volume suggest conviction hasn't fully converted to fresh buying. Bitcoin's 58.2% dominance shows retail and institutional attention remains concentrated on the largest asset rather than spreading into altcoins.
